name: ClearStar
summary: ClearStar lists three screening plans (Basic, Standard and Professional) but shows no prices and asks buyers to request them. Its Smart Screen offer runs instant criminal screening powered by Equifax, a customer testimonial credits it with easy applicant authorizations by text or email, and its homepage names seven HR technology partners.

facts.text: The Basic plan includes a national criminal database search and the first three county court criminal checks, with pass-through fees.
The Standard plan adds one education verification and two employment verifications, and Professional adds two professional reference verifications.
The homepage lists seven integration partners: SAP, Paycor, Workday, eightfold.ai, Dayforce, SmartRecruiters and Employ.
A customer testimonial credits ClearStar with the ease of applicant authorizations by text or email, and the vendor pages we read did not describe the consent flow itself.
